name: Disable Diagnostic Data Collection
warnings: Limits Windows diagnostics and crash reporting features
commands:
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v AllowTelemetry /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
 
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v MaxTelemetryAllowed /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
 
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\DiagTrack" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f
